name: shadcn-ui expansions
summary: 14 extra shadcn/ui components: multiple selector, loading button, infinite scroll, datetime picker, spinner and more.
description: Additional copy-paste components built on top of shadcn/ui: autosize textarea, blockquote, floating label input, heading with anchor, infinite scroll, loading button, magic back button, multiple selector, datetime picker, spinner, dual range slider, progress with value, responsive modal and typewriter. It also ships a rate limit library. Demo at shadcnui-expansions.typeart.cc; MIT licensed.
